meal.title: Static method without self
meal.objective: Define a method that does not take self and can be called on the class

voice.script: What if you could call a function without an object? That's what a static method lets you do. In Python you add the @staticmethod decorator before a function inside a class. The decorator tells Python this method doesn't need the instance, so you can call it on the class itself. Here’s a tiny class. We define class Student. Inside we put a regular method greet that prints a greeting using self.name. Then we add @staticmethod above a method eligible that receives an age and returns True if age is at least eighteen. Because it has no self, we call Student.eligible(20) and it returns True. We also create a Student object named Alice and call alice.greet() to show the normal method still works. Running the program prints the greeting and then prints that twenty is adult: True.
